as_told.title: Non-human biologics recovered with craft (hearing clip)

plain: Some people claim that a secret US program has recovered crashed craft that are not of human make, and that bodies or other biological remains, called "biologics", came with some of them. David Grusch, who has gone public about these programs, says it most strongly, repeating what he says he was told by people "with direct knowledge" who are still in the program. In a clip from his testimony to Congress, he says those remains were judged to be non-human. He adds that he already said so in a TV interview with the news channel NewsNation. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he carried a recovered UFO, says there are "reports that we do have biologics in storage and we just don't know what that is." The UFO reporter Jeremy Corbell says he has heard the same, "mostly autopsy reports." Neither Barber nor Corbell ties the remains to a particular crash. If true, it would mean the government holds the bodies of whoever flew these craft.
